triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Triage: lands in `area:ux` · `domain:spec` · `priority:p2` · Bug · `pm:blocked` (Blocked-by: #36919) · size XS.
Rationale: a wrong sentence shipped to authors is a Bug at p2, because builders hit it often. It is blocked because the sentence is still true on main and becomes wrong only when #36919 merges. The unlock scan moves it to `pm:queue` when #36919 closes. If seat 3 would rather carry the fix inside #36919, it closes this card as done there. Seat 3 takes it, as its request said.

triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Scope addition, at seat 3's amendment (mailbox #36743, comment 7127423473): the same PR also fixes `packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, row `list.bulkActionDefs`. That row still says only `accept` / `maxSize` plus four picker settings reach a bulk dialog from the field, and tells authors to remove `allowCreate`. After #36919 it must name `allowCreate` among the carried keys, in the same words as the prescription.

Acceptance, added: the `list.bulkActionDefs` liveness row and the `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` prescription say the same thing about `allowCreate`, and both match #36919.

triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Correction to my scope addition above: on main, the `list.bulkActionDefs` note in `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` lists the carried field keys and leaves `allowCreate` off that list. It does not name `allowCreate` or tell authors to remove it in so many words; that was my over-quote of the request. The fix is unchanged: add `allowCreate` to the carried keys there once #36919 lands.
